Triage (unified triage seat, completing the label-only half-state — `bug`+`pm:queue` were applied at 22:04Z without an audit comment; classification confirmed): type `Bug`, stays `pm:queue`. Cross-wired label association (resolves to the *wrong* control) measured on a real render; duplicate DOM ids are an invariant violation, so this is direct-fix territory, not a decision card — the "交维护者裁" the card requests is answered at the seat level: take **direction 1 (path-scoped ids)**, which the card itself prefers — declarative, predictable, compatible with the existing `mdf-{name}` selector surface at the top level (top-level fields keep their current ids; only nested rows gain a path prefix). Direction 2 (`useId()`) breaks every existing selector and loses derivability, for no added correctness.

Dispatch notes: before coding, census in-tree consumers of `mdf-` selectors (tests/e2e) and state in the PR which ids changed (nested rows only, expected). Closed sibling #3343 (`packages/fields` fixed-id collision) is the repair precedent. Hot-file note: `SchemaForm.tsx` is shared with #5063's surface (`RepeaterField` grid branch) and PR #5061 just landed there — serial with #5063 (one claim may take both; they are same-file, different mechanisms) and rebase over #5061 first. Size/model suggestion: S–M / opus.
